title: Fzj80 to 1hz conversion
transmission: H151F gearbox (carried over from 1FZ) fitted with 1HDT clutch and flywheel for compatibility
ai_summary: Early-stage build thread for converting a 1993 FZJ80 from its factory 1FZ gas engine to a 1HZ diesel. Forum members advised that because the 1FZ's H151F gearbox uses coarser splines than the stock 1HZ clutch/flywheel, a 1HDT clutch and flywheel assembly (larger capacity) is needed for the swap. No performance figures or completion updates were present in the thread.

complications.detail: H151F gearbox spline/clutch mismatch with standard 1HZ clutch parts; requires 1HDT clutch and flywheel
Bellhousing compatibility confirmed via HDJ80 sourcing; engine mounts reported as identical between 1FZ and 1HZ
